title: DOE Providing $2.8B Loan for Wyoming Intertie

meta.summary:
The U.S. Department of Energy will provide a $2.8 billion conditional loan to Grid United for a 106-mile Wyoming transmission line that will connect SPP’s Eastern Interconnection footprint with the Western Interconnection. 
 The post  DOE Providing $2.8B Loan for Wyoming Intertie  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
